notes: Mayor Adams and DOE Chancellor Banks launched the citywide "NYC School Bus App" ("developed in collaboration with Via"), a parent/caregiver real-time GPS tracking tool for existing yellow school bus routes. "For families to utilize the NYC School Bus App, the assigned route driver must be subscribed to the platform" and references "bus vendors and drivers" and "school bus company" as the operators - DOE's existing contracted bus vendors supply drivers/vehicles; Via supplies the tracking software only, so Software-only.

Regional Transit Service (RTS/RGRTA) switched RTS On Demand to a "new platform powered by Via" effective Sept. 28, 2022 (dateline in cached article body), replacing the prior software/app in use since May 2021; the enum date field listed 2024-02-27 (likely a CMS republish/display date) but the article dateline and described effective date are Sept. 28, 2022, used here. Article frames this purely as a software swap ("RTS On Demand service days, service times, fares, payment types, zone boundaries, and guidelines remain the same"; "RTS Customer Service" continues) with no mention of Via supplying vehicles/drivers, so Software-only, drivers/vehicles = agency (RTS). Two gnews leads for this target ("Rochester Transit Workers Cautiously Optimistic About Non-Renewal of Transdev's Contract" and "New operator chosen for Rochester buses in $77.8M transit contract - kttc.com") excluded as false matches: kttc.com is the Rochester, MINNESOTA TV station (per target notes, RGRTA is Rochester, NEW YORK, distinct from Rochester Public Transit MN/T113), and neither mentions Via, RTS, or RGRTA by name - both concern a Transdev fixed-route operating contract in the other Rochester.

Monroe County Transportation Authority ("Pocono Pony") switched its existing PonyPlus on-demand service (offered by MCTA) to a new app "powered by Via" effective Sept. 1, 2023, replacing its prior TransitTech/app provider. MCTA CEO: "We have selected Via as our software provider." No mention of Via supplying vehicles or drivers; PonyPlus is described throughout as "the on-demand transportation service offered by" MCTA, so Software-only, drivers/vehicles = agency (MCTA).
